# delax-ops

> Operational nucleus for DELAX. Holds shared ops docs, database schemas, and automation scripts that power the other DELAX repos. No vendored shared packages — those live in `delax-shared-packages`.

## What this is

delax-ops is the cross-cutting operational layer for DELAX projects. It tracks the repo map, owns shared DB design and migrations, and houses scheduled jobs and media-pipeline automation. Secrets are kept out of the repo; runtime credentials come from environment variables and GitHub Actions secrets.

- Scope: db schemas, scheduled jobs, media pipeline utilities
- Secrets: never committed — env / GitHub Actions only
- Vendoring policy: this repo does not vendor shared packages

## Related repos

- [delax-shared-packages](https://github.com/DELAxGithub/delax-shared-packages) — shared TypeScript packages (`@delax/agent-harness`, `@delax/review-commons`, etc.)

## What this is NOT

- Not a public-facing product — this is internal ops infrastructure
- Not a code library — runtime code lives in `delax-shared-packages`, not here
- Not a secrets store — all secrets are external to the repo
- Not a single-app monorepo — projects live in their own repos and reference this one
